# Cybergaar

Cybergaar provides cyber security assurance services: security audits, ISO 27001
implementation, ISO audit support, application security testing, vulnerability scanning,
and penetration testing. Work is described in concrete terms focused on reducing real
exposure and making the next action clear.

## What Cybergaar does

- Security audits and compliance readiness (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, Cyber Essentials,
  GDPR, HIPAA, NIST CSF, DORA, NIS2, SAMA, CMMC and more).
- Vulnerability scanning across networks, applications, hosts, databases, authenticated
  and unauthenticated environments, and cloud-native workloads.
- Penetration testing across web, mobile, network, cloud, wireless, social engineering and
  IoT/embedded systems.
- Practical remediation guidance and readiness support, delivered without overstating
  certification outcomes.

## Services

- [ISO 27001](https://cybergaar.com/services/iso-27001): ISMS readiness, gap assessment,
  control evidence and certification audit support.
- [PCI DSS](https://cybergaar.com/services/pci-dss): readiness and implementation support
  for organisations processing card payments.
- [SOC 2](https://cybergaar.com/services/soc-2): control design and evidence support for
  SaaS and technology companies.
- [Cyber Essentials](https://cybergaar.com/services/cyber-essentials): UK baseline
  certification readiness and remediation.
- [Vulnerability scanning](https://cybergaar.com/services/vulnerability-scanning): network,
  host, database, cloud and authenticated scanning with validation.
- [Penetration testing](https://cybergaar.com/services/penetration-testing): manual testing
  across web, mobile, network, cloud, wireless, social engineering and IoT.

## Regions

Cybergaar serves a global audience with site variants for the United Kingdom
(https://cybergaar.com/uk) and Pakistan (https://cybergaar.com/pk).

## Contact

Email hello@cybergaar.com to discuss an engagement or scope a security audit or test.
